| Dataset path | Shape | Dtype |
|---|---|---|
| /channel | (384,) | int32 |
| /crs | () (scalar) | uint8 |
| /das | (30000, 384) | float32 |
| /t | (30000,) | float64 |
| /trace | (30000,) | int64 |
| /x | (384,) | float32 |
| /y | (384,) | float32 |
| /z | (384,) | float32 |

Notes: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30,000 time samples x 384 channels); /t is the matching time axis (30,000 samples); /channel, /x, /y, /z are per-channel metadata arrays of length 384 (channel IDs and cable coordinates); /trace is a 30,000-element integer trace index; /crs is a scalar (uint8) holding the coordinate reference system string. The file was opened read-only and closed after inspection; no data was read from /das.
